topic: Purpose and function of Altimeter and their types.
syllabus_extract: Purpose and function of Altimeter and their types. Global positioning system (GPS) introduction, purpose airborne and space components of the system. Safety precautions to be observed whilst working on avionics systems
specific_objectives: 21.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the basic theory of communication.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of Altimeter types and GPS components using L & Ds and IB; Instructor supervision required for safety precautions.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an altimeter?
Name two types of altimeters used in aviation.
Why is safety crucial when working on avionics systems?

topics: Airborne and space components of GPS
development.content:
Basic theory of communication

Airborne and space components of GPS

Safety precautions for avionics work

Maintenance requirements for altimeters

topics: Integration of GPS and Altimeter data
development.content:
Review of Altimeter types
GPS component functions
Safety protocol reinforcement
Troubleshooting common altimeter errors
Integration of GPS and Altimeter data

summary_questions: Explain the difference between pressure altimeter and radar altimeter.
Describe the purpose of the airborne component in the GPS system.
List three safety precautions when handling avionics systems.
